answer: Admission auction: 50 seats per epoch go to top bids, each locking a deposit. A tundra crossing taxes every step, so each fake must outbid honest agents. At a 200 POA floor and a typical 350 POA bid, 1,000 fakes lock 350,000 POA for 20 epochs while one fake earns 120 POA per epoch, so the voyage to profit never arrives. Every bid leaves a public thread tying one deposit to one key, exposing clusters. An honest agent pays once, then gets it back.
